summary: Read one price for each day, listed from earlier days to later days. A single trade buys on one day and sells on a strictly later day, and no second trade is allowed. Profit equals the selling price minus the buying price. When no later price is higher, the profit is zero. Find the largest profit among all legal pairs of days and write that number.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
